Import as DRAFT (review then publish). These are ms/* (Marie's voice), servable. Context values on synastry cells (core/partner/ex/family/coworkers/friends) select by relationship type.

templateRows.headline: Jupiter Conjunct Neptune (core)
templateRows.body: their confidence, encouragement, or appetite for possibility enlarges your imagination, hope, or idealism, makes a possibility feel more believable, and can make it harder to judge what is realistic

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Ascendant (core)
templateRows.body: their standards, caution, or criticism affect how freely you present yourself and enter situations, may help you prepare, and may also leave you self-conscious or overly careful

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mars (core)
templateRows.body: their questions or delivery meet your drive to act, so talk can move to argument fast, because their words provoke a reaction and your reaction gives them more to answer

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Mars (core)
templateRows.body: their wish to keep things pleasant meets your urge to address things directly, so affection and irritation can coexist and differences in timing turn desire or cooperation into friction

templateRows.headline: Sun Conjunct Moon (core)
templateRows.body: their sense of identity and direction sits right on your feelings and needs, so who they are shapes your mood almost automatically, which can feel like being understood or like being overshadowed

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Moon (core)
templateRows.body: their standards, caution, or restraint press on your emotional needs at an angle that keeps catching, so their seriousness can land as coldness until you can feel secure without their constant reassurance

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Mars (core)
templateRows.body: their affection and taste meet your drive and desire with almost no resistance, so wanting and being liked line up easily, and it coordinates so smoothly it can go unexamined

templateRows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn (core)
templateRows.body: their confidence and need to be seen press against your caution and standards, so you may find yourself wanting to steady or check them, each of you holding a different end

templateRows.headline: Moon Sextile Venus (core)
templateRows.body: their moods and needs meet your affection and taste in a low-pressure way, so warmth is available when either of you reaches for it and quietly passes by when no one does

templateRows.headline: Moon Conjunct Moon (core)
templateRows.body: the two of you share very similar emotional rhythms and needs, so you tend to feel things at the same time, which is deeply comforting and can also amplify a low mood with little contrast to balance it

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mercury (core)
templateRows.body: the two of you think and talk in ways that keep catching on each other, similar enough to engage constantly and different enough to misread each other, so conversation can turn to friction until you adjust

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Venus (core)
templateRows.body: the two of you value and enjoy similar things and express affection in compatible ways, so liking each other comes naturally and shared taste makes time together pleasant, easy enough to take for granted

templateRows.headline: Sun Square Moon (core)
templateRows.body: their drive to be seen and do things their way keeps rubbing against what you need to feel safe, so their confidence can unsettle your comfort at an angle that keeps catching

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Saturn (core)
templateRows.body: their affection and wish for closeness keep meeting your caution and reserve, so their warmth can feel like pressure while your restraint can feel like coldness

templateRows.headline: Mars Conjunct Venus (core)
templateRows.body: their drive and desire land right on your affection and taste, so wanting and being wanted move fast between you, easy to act on before you have thought it through

templateRows.headline: Mars Conjunct Mars (core)
templateRows.body: the two of you go after what you want in very similar ways, so you can move in strong sync and also collide when two identical drives both want the wheel

templateRows.headline: Jupiter Conjunct Neptune (partner)
templateRows.body: Their confidence can make the future you imagine together feel possible. You may find it easier to share dreams with them because they respond with enthusiasm instead of immediately pointing out everything that could go wrong. That encouragement can carry the relationship forward, but it can also make an exciting idea feel more settled than it is. Check what the two of you are actually building before making promises around the life you hope to have.

templateRows.headline: Jupiter Conjunct Neptune (ex)
templateRows.body: Their confidence may have made the relationship feel full of possibility. You may have imagined what the two of you could become and given that future more weight than what was happening between you at the time. Looking back, separate the promises that were followed by action from the ones that only kept hope alive. You can value what the relationship helped you imagine without continuing to wait for it.

templateRows.headline: Jupiter Conjunct Neptune (family)
templateRows.body: They may encourage your hopes even when the practical details are still missing. That can help you take an idea seriously, especially in a family that usually responds to change with worry. It can also lead to big promises, unrealistic expectations, or plans that no one knows how to carry out. Before everyone gets attached to the outcome, decide who is responsible for the next real step.

templateRows.headline: Jupiter Conjunct Neptune (coworkers)
templateRows.body: They can make an ambitious idea sound possible, and you may be the person who sees how much potential it could have. This is useful during brainstorming, pitching, and early creative work. Problems begin when enthusiasm replaces a clear scope, budget, or deadline. Put the plan in writing before the team commits resources to it.

templateRows.headline: Jupiter Conjunct Neptune (friends)
templateRows.body: They make it easier to talk about the big idea you have been afraid to take seriously. Their encouragement can help you move beyond self-doubt and imagine more for yourself. They may also agree with the dream before either of you has checked whether it can work. Let them encourage you, then ask the practical questions together.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Ascendant (partner)
templateRows.body: They may make you more aware of how you come across, especially when they question a choice, correct your behavior, or expect you to slow down. Their judgment may help you think something through, but repeated criticism can leave you rehearsing ordinary decisions before you bring them up. They need to be able to raise a concern without taking authority over how you present yourself.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Ascendant (ex)
templateRows.body: You may still hear their criticism when you make choices they once questioned. Even after the relationship ends, you can find yourself preparing a defense for decisions they no longer have any say in. Review which concerns were useful and which ones taught you to doubt yourself. Their standards do not need to remain the standard you use now.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Ascendant (family)
templateRows.body: They may have strong ideas about how you should behave, what choices are responsible, or how the family will judge your decisions. Because the relationship comes with history, their concern can quickly sound like authority even when you are capable of deciding for yourself. Useful advice needs to leave room for you to make a different choice.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Ascendant (coworkers)
templateRows.body: They may scrutinize how you present an idea, respond in meetings, or handle responsibility. Their caution can improve your preparation, especially when accuracy matters. It becomes difficult when every contribution begins to feel like an evaluation. Feedback works better when it addresses the work directly instead of turning into a judgment about your competence.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Ascendant (friends)
templateRows.body: They may question your choices more quickly than other friends do. Sometimes that helps you catch a problem before you walk into it. Sometimes it leaves you feeling as though you need permission before doing something spontaneous. The friendship works better when concern is offered as an opinion rather than a final decision.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mars (partner)
templateRows.body: They may question an idea while you are still trying to act on it. You can hear their questions as obstruction and respond before you have understood what they meant. Arguments move quickly because their words provoke action and your reaction gives them more to answer. Slow the exchange down enough to decide whether you disagree with the idea or with the way it was delivered.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mars (ex)
templateRows.body: Conversations with them may still move from ordinary to argumentative very quickly. A question can sound like the beginning of an old fight, and you may answer the history behind it instead of the words they are using now. Keep present-day communication narrow and clear. You do not need to reopen the entire relationship to settle one practical matter.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mars (family)
templateRows.body: A normal conversation can turn into an old argument fast, because their questions land on you as challenges and you answer the history behind them instead of the point in front of you. The same disputes tend to reopen at gatherings before anyone notices it starting. Keep exchanges short and specific, and step away before a familiar fight restarts.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mars (coworkers)
templateRows.body: They may question your approach while you are mid-execution, and under a deadline that can feel like obstruction. You answer quickly, which gives them more to question, and the loop eats time you do not have. Decide whether you actually disagree with the idea or just dislike the delivery, and move contested points into writing.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mars (friends)
templateRows.body: Banter can tip into a real edge when their questioning meets your wish to just act on it. It sharpens you both and occasionally cuts deeper than either of you intended. When a remark stings, say so early rather than letting it build into a standoff.

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Mars (partner)
templateRows.body: They may want warmth and reassurance at the same moment you want a direct answer or physical response. The attraction can be strong, but differences in timing can turn desire into irritation. Say what you want before expecting the other person to recognize it from the tension alone.

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Mars (ex)
templateRows.body: The attraction and irritation may have been difficult to separate while you were together. Contact now can restart both at once, especially when one of you reaches for warmth and the other pushes for an answer. Decide what the conversation is for before relying on chemistry to carry it.

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Mars (family)
templateRows.body: They may try to preserve peace while you want the family to acknowledge what is wrong. That can leave you feeling dismissed and leave them feeling as though you create conflict whenever everyone else is trying to move on. Peace will not last if it depends on avoiding the subject. Choose a time to address it when neither of you is already reacting.

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Mars (coworkers)
templateRows.body: They may focus on tone, presentation, or keeping everyone comfortable while you focus on speed and execution. Both concerns can improve the work, but the difference can create arguments about how a decision should be communicated. Agree on the outcome first, then decide who handles the conversation and who handles the immediate task.

templateRows.headline: Venus Square Mars (friends)
templateRows.body: They may try to keep an interaction pleasant while you want to address the problem immediately. You can find their diplomacy evasive, while they may experience your directness as unnecessary pressure. This friendship handles conflict better when neither of you makes the other person's style the problem. Decide what needs to be said now and what can wait until the temperature comes down.

templateRows.headline: Sun Conjunct Moon (partner)
templateRows.body: Their presence sets your emotional weather. When they are steady and warm, you settle just being near them; when they are off, you feel it before they say anything. This closeness is real, and it can quietly make your sense of security depend on their state. Keep a few things that steady you on your own, so being close stays a comfort rather than a thermostat.

templateRows.headline: Sun Conjunct Moon (ex)
templateRows.body: This is why their mood can still move you. Hearing how they are doing may shift your whole day, because your feelings learned to track theirs. Notice that pull without treating it as a reason to reengage; being easily affected by someone is not the same as the relationship being right. Give yourself the steadiness you once borrowed from their presence.

templateRows.headline: Sun Conjunct Moon (family)
templateRows.body: This is often the relative whose mood sets the temperature of the room, and you feel it in your body before a word is spoken. You may have learned to read them closely and adjust yourself to keep things smooth. That attunement is a skill, and you are still allowed to feel differently than they do. Check what you actually feel underneath their mood before you match it.

templateRows.headline: Sun Conjunct Moon (coworkers)
templateRows.body: You are unusually sensitive to their state day to day, and it colors how the work feels. When they are confident, you work better; when they withdraw, you may assume something is wrong, sometimes without cause. Do not read an off day as a verdict on you or the project. Ask directly how they are doing instead of absorbing it and guessing.

templateRows.headline: Sun Conjunct Moon (friends)
templateRows.body: This is easy closeness, the person you relax around right away. Their energy lifts or settles yours, and time together tends to restore you. The one risk is syncing downward, matching their low moods instead of offering a steadier one. Be the friend who holds steady when they dip, rather than sinking with them.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Moon (partner)
templateRows.body: You may feel your needs are too much for them, or that they answer warmth with restraint. They often do not mean to withhold; seriousness is just their reflex under pressure. Over time this can build real security or slowly chill the bond, depending on whether they learn to reach back. Say plainly what you need instead of testing whether they will guess it.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Moon (ex)
templateRows.body: This may be the ache you remember, reaching for warmth and meeting a wall. Looking back, separate the times they genuinely could not meet you from the times you needed more than anyone could give. The useful lesson is that someone's emotional caution did not make you unlovable. Take it, and stop waiting at that wall.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Moon (family)
templateRows.body: This is often the relative whose approval felt earned rather than given, whose seriousness shaped how safe it was to have feelings. You may still tense up and manage your emotions to avoid their disapproval. The pattern is old and not your fault, and it is now yours to update. You can stay close to them and stop auditioning for warmth they may not perform.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Moon (coworkers)
templateRows.body: Their standards and your need for a supportive tone keep colliding. They give feedback bluntly and it can sting personally, even when it is only about the work. Try to hear the seriousness as rigor rather than rejection, and do not route your sense of worth through their approval. Ask for the specific input you need instead of the reassurance they will not offer.

templateRows.headline: Saturn Square Moon (friends)
templateRows.body: This is the one who is a little harder to feel close to, who shows care through reliability more than warmth. You may wish they were softer, and they may find your needs demanding. The friendship works when you translate: their showing up is their affection. Ask directly for comfort when you need it rather than hoping they will sense it.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Mars (partner)
templateRows.body: This is easy chemistry and easy give-and-take, where your initiative is met with warmth instead of friction. Desire and affection tend to flow the same direction, which makes closeness feel natural. Because it is effortless, you can stop tending it and assume it will always be there. Keep choosing it out loud, so the ease stays felt rather than taken for granted.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Mars (ex)
templateRows.body: This may be the easy attraction you remember, the sense that wanting each other was simple. Looking back, notice that easy chemistry was not the whole story, and comfort is not the same as fit. You can appreciate how good the flow felt without needing it back. Let it have been easy and still be finished.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Mars (family)
templateRows.body: This shows up as genuine warmth and easy cooperation, the relative you enjoy doing things with. Effort and affection move in the same direction, so being around them is pleasant and low-friction. The only risk is coasting and under-investing because it asks so little. Make a little effort even when none is required, so the good ease keeps its warmth.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Mars (coworkers)
templateRows.body: There is natural rapport that makes collaboration smooth; your push and their goodwill fit together. Work gets easier and more pleasant when you team up. The risk is relying on the good feeling and never building it into something more substantial. Let the ease support real work rather than just a nice dynamic.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Mars (friends)
templateRows.body: This is playful, easy energy, the person it is fun to make plans and do things with. Your initiative and their warmth match, so time together feels good and uncomplicated. Because it is so easy, you might drift and under-invest. Keep reaching out even when nothing is needed, so the easy bond does not quietly fade.

templateRows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn (partner)
templateRows.body: You may catch yourself being the responsible one, tempering their enthusiasm or worrying about what they overlook. That can steady the relationship, and it can also cast you as the brake and them as the engine until both of you resent the roles. Notice when caution has become control. Offer your steadiness as support rather than as a limit on who they get to be.

templateRows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn (ex)
templateRows.body: You may look back and see how much you carried the weight, or how their bigness and your caution kept pulling against each other. Sort out where your restraint was wisdom and where it was fear. You can keep what you learned about responsibility without deciding their confidence was the problem. Let the roles you fell into stay in the past.

templateRows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn (family)
templateRows.body: This can be the relative whose choices you find yourself judging or reining in, often because you feel responsible for consequences they seem to ignore. The history makes your concern sound like authority even when they did not ask. Real support leaves room for them to make their own call. Say your piece once, then let their life be theirs.

templateRows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn (coworkers)
templateRows.body: Their visibility and your caution can grind, especially if you are the one accountable for the risks they want to take. Your standards can genuinely improve their ideas, and they can also feel policed. Aim your caution at the work, not at their ambition. Flag the specific risk rather than dampening the whole thing.

templateRows.headline: Sun Opposition Saturn (friends)
templateRows.body: You may play the sober voice to their big energy, the one who asks whether they have thought it through. Sometimes that saves them trouble; sometimes it makes you the friend who rains on things. Offer the reality check as an opinion, not a ruling. Let them be big, and trust them to hear a concern once you have said it.

templateRows.headline: Moon Sextile Venus (partner)
templateRows.body: There is an easy tenderness here that grows when you tend it; small gestures land well and comfort comes readily. It is not loud, so it can be overlooked in a busy stretch. A little initiative goes a long way. Reach for the warm gesture rather than waiting for the mood to arrive on its own.

templateRows.headline: Moon Sextile Venus (ex)
templateRows.body: This was probably the gentle, comfortable side of things, easy affection whenever either of you offered it. Looking back, remember it was pleasant but quiet, not the whole measure of the bond. You can value the softness without inflating it into something larger than it was. Let it be a good, small memory.

templateRows.headline: Moon Sextile Venus (family)
templateRows.body: This is a low-key warmth that responds when you make a little effort, the relative who softens when you reach out. It asks something small of you to stay alive. It is easy to let it lapse because it never demands attention. Send the message or make the visit; this bond rewards the small reach.

templateRows.headline: Moon Sextile Venus (coworkers)
templateRows.body: There is a pleasant, easy rapport that improves when you invest a little; a kind word or small consideration is met warmly. It can quietly strengthen how you work together. Left untended, it just stays surface. Offer the small courtesy; it turns a fine working relationship into a genuinely good one.

templateRows.headline: Moon Sextile Venus (friends)
templateRows.body: This is comfortable, responsive warmth that grows with a bit of effort from either side. Reach out and it flourishes; ignore it and it simply idles. It never demands anything, which is why it can drift. Be the one who initiates sometimes, and the ease turns into real closeness.

templateRows.headline: Moon Conjunct Moon (partner)
templateRows.body: You understand each other's feelings almost without words, and home tends to feel like a shared emotional language. The flip side is that when one of you sinks, the other often sinks too, with no one on steadier ground. Notice when you are amplifying each other rather than soothing. Take turns being the calm one so a hard mood does not double.

templateRows.headline: Moon Conjunct Moon (ex)
templateRows.body: The emotional sync may be part of what made contact so charged, then and now. You may still fall into each other's moods quickly, which can blur where one of you ends. Keep contact clear and bounded so the old shared weather does not take over. You can honor how well you understood each other without living in that climate again.

templateRows.headline: Moon Conjunct Moon (family)
templateRows.body: You two likely operate on the same wavelength and feel each other's moods strongly, for better and worse. It can be a real comfort and can also mean you escalate together when things get tense. Notice when you are feeding the same feeling back and forth. One of you stepping out of the loop steadies both.

templateRows.headline: Moon Conjunct Moon (coworkers)
templateRows.body: You read each other's states easily and tend to sync emotionally, which makes for smooth rapport when you are both steady. When you are both stressed about the same deadline, you can spiral together with no one holding a calmer view. Watch for mutual stress coloring shared judgment. When you notice you are both anxious about the same problem, get an outside read before deciding.

templateRows.headline: Moon Conjunct Moon (friends)
templateRows.body: This is the person who just gets how you feel, and time together can be deeply restorative. Because you match so easily, you can also sink into a low mood together and call it bonding. Be willing to offer a different note when your friend is down. Matching every feeling is not the same as helping.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mercury (partner)
templateRows.body: You talk a lot and also snag a lot, misreading tone or intent more often than you would expect from two people who click mentally. The friction is usually about how something was said, not what was meant. Slow down and check the meaning before reacting to the delivery. Ask what they meant rather than answering what you assumed.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mercury (ex)
templateRows.body: Conversations may still turn tangled or sharp quickly, the same crossed wires reappearing. A simple exchange can reopen an old misread. Keep present communication short, literal, and about the matter at hand. You do not need to untangle every old misunderstanding to handle one clear thing.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mercury (family)
templateRows.body: You two may reliably talk past each other, repeating the same miscommunication at gatherings until it feels like a rut. The disagreement is often about wording and habit more than substance. Name the pattern and change how you say things rather than relitigating the content. When it starts, restate what you heard before responding.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mercury (coworkers)
templateRows.body: Your thinking styles clash enough to cause repeated mix-ups over instructions, tone, or scope, especially under time pressure. It can look like conflict when it is really two wiring styles missing each other. Put important things in writing and confirm understanding both ways. Agree on terms before you both assume you meant the same one.

templateRows.headline: Mercury Square Mercury (friends)
templateRows.body: Banter and debate come easily and can also tip into misreading each other, where a joke or a point lands wrong. You sharpen each other and occasionally cross wires. When something stings or confuses, clarify early instead of building a case. A quick check on what they meant prevents most of it.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Venus (partner)
templateRows.body: You tend to want the same kinds of pleasures and show love in ways the other easily receives, which makes daily affection simple. Because it flows, you can stop noticing it and let it go unspoken. Ease is not the same as attention. Name what you appreciate out loud, so the natural warmth stays felt.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Venus (ex)
templateRows.body: Shared taste and easy affection were probably a real comfort, the part that felt effortless. Looking back, remember that liking the same things is not the same as being right for each other. You can appreciate the ease without reading more into it. Let the good taste you shared be a fond, finished thing.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Venus (family)
templateRows.body: You two enjoy similar things and get along with little friction, the relative you find it easy to be around. It is a genuine gift, especially where family closeness is often harder. Do not let it fade just because it asks nothing. Plan the outing you both enjoy; easy warmth still likes to be chosen.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Venus (coworkers)
templateRows.body: You share sensibilities about how things should look or feel, which makes collaboration pleasant and low-friction. You agree easily, which is nice and can also mean you skip useful challenge. Enjoy the rapport and still invite other views. Let the ease support the work rather than smoothing over decisions that need debate.

templateRows.headline: Venus Trine Venus (friends)
templateRows.body: This is comfortable, aligned taste, the person who likes what you like and is easy to spend time with. It is low-maintenance and warm. The only risk is coasting and letting it drift because it never demands effort. Reach out and make plans; the ease becomes real closeness when you tend it.

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 1 house
templateRows.body: immediate and personal: appearance, behavior, confidence, how freely someone acts

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 2 house
templateRows.body: money, possessions, priorities, self-worth, effort, what is worth the cost

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 3 house
templateRows.body: conversation, texting, teasing, arguments, tone, interruptions, siblings, errands, daily coordination

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 4 house
templateRows.body: home, privacy, family expectations, living arrangements, emotional history, control of the domestic environment

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 5 house
templateRows.body: dating, play, creativity, attention, competition, pleasure, children (romantic language needs a romantic designation)

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 6 house
templateRows.body: chores, schedules, work habits, health routines, practical help, resentment over who does what

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 7 house
templateRows.body: agreements, cooperation, direct conflict, negotiation, expectations of partnership (not automatically romance)

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 8 house
templateRows.body: shared money, trust, privacy, dependency, obligations, sex in explicitly romantic contexts, discomfort over what is owed

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 9 house
templateRows.body: beliefs, politics, education, travel, religion, advice, arguments about what is right

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 10 house
templateRows.body: career, reputation, authority, ambition, public decisions, support or interference with the other's direction

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 11 house
templateRows.body: friendship, group participation, shared goals, social circles, belonging, disagreements about the future

templateRows.headline: House overlay — 12 house
templateRows.body: private frustration, unclear motives, avoided conflict, hidden attraction (romantic only), hard-to-name irritation

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/sun
templateRows.body: The relationship's Sun is its reason for being, what you two become together that neither of you is alone. Its sign is the core character of the bond, and its house shows the part of life the relationship is really about.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/moon
templateRows.body: The relationship's Moon is its emotional climate, how safe it feels to be inside it and what it needs to feel held. Its sign is the mood you two default to, and its house is where the relationship goes for comfort.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/mercury
templateRows.body: The relationship's Mercury is how you two think and talk as a unit, whether words come easily and what you keep coming back to. Its house shows where the conversation between you actually lives.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/venus
templateRows.body: The relationship's Venus is its capacity for pleasure, affection, and ease, the glue of genuinely liking each other. Its sign shows how the bond expresses love, and its house shows where it feels good to be together.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/mars
templateRows.body: The relationship's Mars is its shared drive and its friction, how you two go after things and how you fight. Its house shows where the heat and the conflict tend to land.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/jupiter
templateRows.body: The relationship's Jupiter is where it grows and feels generous, the room the bond gives you both to expand. Its house shows the part of life the relationship makes bigger.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/saturn
templateRows.body: The relationship's Saturn is its backbone and its weight, what commits you two and where it feels heavy or tested. Its house shows where the bond has to do the serious work if it wants to last.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/uranus
templateRows.body: The relationship's Uranus is its need for freedom and its knack for surprise, where routine kills it and space keeps it alive. Its house shows where the bond refuses to be predictable.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/neptune
templateRows.body: The relationship's Neptune is its shared dream and its blind spot, the ideal you two reach for and the place you can quietly fool each other. Its house shows where the bond is most romantic and least clear-eyed.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/pluto
templateRows.body: The relationship's Pluto is its depth and its power dynamic, how the bond transforms you both and where control becomes a question. Its house shows where the relationship goes all the way to the bottom of things.

templateRows.headline: Composite — planet/ascendant
templateRows.body: The relationship's Rising is its face to the world, how you two come across as a pair and the first impression the bond gives off. Its sign is the vibe people pick up before they know anything else about you together.
